reason: Remove a pre-implementation ambiguity between table formal parameters and APPLY_TABLE call-site source bindings, and make the input-source namespace explicit. The correction narrows interpretation before any W7/W8 implementation or C3 authority exists.
supersession_rule: Where this amendment conflicts with RISU_KERNEL_K1_MFST_C3_PROFILE.json or RISU_KERNEL_K1_MFST_C3_WIRE.json, this amendment is normative for C3 v1 qualification. All non-conflicting rules remain unchanged.

source_namespace.input_resolution: If name is @world, the source domain is the exact boundary world set. Otherwise name must be an exact declared boundary slot and the source domain is that slot's exact declared domain.
source_namespace.state_resolution: name must be an exact declared state cell and the source domain is that cell's exact declared domain.
source_namespace.namespace_rule: @world is a valid input source but may not be declared as a user boundary slot.

state_initialization_correction.const: unchanged: initial value must be in the destination state-cell domain
state_initialization_correction.input: initial.name may be @world or an exact declared boundary slot; the complete resolved input domain must be a subset of the destination state-cell domain

table_formal_argument_schema.argument_name: unique token-safe formal name within the table; it does not resolve to a machine input or state cell
table_formal_argument_schema.argument_domain: nonempty finite set of unique token-safe values
table_formal_argument_schema.result_domain: nonempty finite set of unique token-safe values
table_formal_argument_schema.rows: exactly one {when,result} row for every tuple in the Cartesian product of formal argument domains
table_formal_argument_schema.row_when: ordered value tuple whose position i belongs to formal argument i domain
table_formal_argument_schema.table_purity: unchanged: no mutation, branch, effect, ambient access, failure channel, or unknown result

apply_table_call_schema.arguments: ordered list of machine source descriptors
apply_table_call_schema.arity: must equal referenced table formal argument count exactly
apply_table_call_schema.domain_binding: for each position i, the fully resolved machine source domain must equal the referenced formal argument i domain exactly
apply_table_call_schema.evaluation: read current source values in argument order, look up the unique total-table row, and assign its result to dst
apply_table_call_schema.destination_rule: the table result_domain must be a subset of the declared dst state-cell domain
apply_table_call_schema.aliasing_rule: A state cell may appear as a source and dst in the same APPLY_TABLE; all arguments are read from the pre-operation state and the single destination write occurs after lookup.

semantic_transcript_correction.replaces: the table section only of risu.k1.mfst.c3.wire/v1 semantic_profile_transcript
table_section: for table in tables sorted by name: ASCII('t') || netstring(name) || count(argument_count) || formal argument encodings in declared order || count(result_domain_size) || sorted result values each ASCII('v') || netstring(value) || count(row_count) || rows sorted lexicographically by canonical when tuple
formal argument encoding: ASCII('a') || netstring(formal_name) || count(domain_size) || for value in sorted unique formal domain: ASCII('v') || netstring(value)
row encoding unchanged: ASCII('r') || count(when_arity) || each when value in formal argument order as ASCII('v') || netstring(value) || ASCII('o') || netstring(result)
semantic_transcript_correction.apply_table_operation_encoding: unchanged: ASCII('3') || netstring(dst) || netstring(table) || count(argument_count) || source_descriptor(call_argument) in declared order
semantic_transcript_correction.effect: Table declaration identity now commits abstract finite function domains independently from machine source names, while each APPLY_TABLE operation separately commits the exact source binding.

differential_vectors_added: AM1-01 table formal argument renamed without changing call binding -> semantic_profile_id changes but execution relation remains equivalent
AM1-02 call-site source changed to a different source with identical domain -> semantic_profile_id changes and checker executes the newly bound source
AM1-03 call-site source domain differs from formal domain -> reject
AM1-04 missing formal table tuple -> reject
AM1-05 duplicate formal table tuple -> reject
AM1-07 @world used as an input source -> valid when its exact world domain matches the receiving/formal domain
AM1-09 APPLY_TABLE reads dst as an argument -> use pre-operation value deterministically
AM1-10 W7/W8 semantic transcript equality under formal-argument declaration permutation rules
nonclaims: This amendment does not widen the effect surface.
This amendment does not add host-language computation.
This amendment does not alter C2 or K1.
This amendment is not evidence that any C3 attack vector passes.
freeze_rule: W7 and W8 must implement the amended semantics from their first executable versions. No checker may select whichever pre-amendment interpretation is convenient.
